d: Watch the official music video for “Dark Necessities” by Red Hot Chili Peppers, the lead single from their 2016 album The Getaway. Built around Flea’s distinctive funk-driven bassline, atmospheric guitar work, and Anthony Kiedis’ vocals, “Dark Necessities” became one of the band’s biggest alternative rock hits of the 2010s, reaching No. 1 on Billboard’s Alternative Airplay chart.
